PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk - Unit Sidoarjo
Management Trainee (Plant - Technic)

Job Responsibilities

• Participate in the Management Trainee development program and gain comprehensive exposure to plant operations.
• Manage and supervise preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities to ensure equipment reliability.
• Implement and optimize CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) practices for maintenance effectiveness.
• Conduct root cause analysis and develop corrective actions to minimize machine downtime.
• Utilize engineering software such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Inventor, and Ansys for mechanical design and analysis activities.
• Support productivity enhancement, energy efficiency, and continuous improvement projects across plant operations.
• Contribute to Industrial IoT implementation initiatives to improve operational performance and digital transformation.
• Ensure compliance with Industrial Safety (K3) standards and ISO 9001:2015 quality management requirements.
• Prepare technical reports, equipment performance analyses, and maintenance improvement recommendations.
• Be willing to undertake assignments and rotational placements across all company locations in Indonesia.

Job Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree (S1/D4) in Mechanical Engineering or Mechatronics Engineering.
• Minimum of 2 years of experience in engineering, maintenance, or manufacturing environments.
• Proficient in both written and spoken English.
• Mandarin language proficiency will be considered an advantage.
• Strong knowledge of SAP PM, AutoCAD 2D/3D, and Microsoft Office applications.
• Proficient in mechanical design and analysis software such as SolidWorks, Ansys, or Inventor.
• Good understanding of CMMS concepts and implementation.
• Strong knowledge of preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance methodologies.
• Solid foundation in mechanical engineering principles with excellent multitasking abilities.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a systematic approach.
• Demonstrated leadership potential, integrity, professionalism, and creativity.
• Familiar with Industrial Safety (K3) regulations and ISO 9001:2015 standards.
• Understanding of Industrial Internet of Things (IoT) concepts and applications.
• Willing to be assigned and relocated to any company operation across Indonesia.

PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk - Unit Sidoarjo
Management Trainee (Plant - Technic)

Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan

• Mengikuti program pengembangan Management Trainee dan memahami seluruh proses operasional plant.
• Mengelola dan mengawasi aktivitas pemeliharaan mesin secara preventive, predictive, dan corrective maintenance.
• Memastikan implementasi sistem maintenance berbasis CMMS untuk meningkatkan efektivitas operasional.
• Melakukan analisis akar masalah (root cause analysis) dan menyusun tindakan perbaikan untuk meminimalkan downtime mesin.
• Mengoperasikan serta memanfaatkan software teknik seperti AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Inventor, atau Ansys untuk kebutuhan desain dan analisis mekanikal.
• Berpartisipasi dalam proyek peningkatan produktivitas, efisiensi energi, dan continuous improvement.
• Mendukung implementasi teknologi industri, termasuk Internet of Things (IoT), dalam proses operasional pabrik.
• Memastikan seluruh aktivitas operasional sesuai dengan standar K3 Industri dan ISO 9001:2015.
• Menyusun laporan teknis, analisis kinerja mesin, dan rekomendasi pengembangan sistem maintenance.
• Bersedia ditempatkan dan menjalankan rotasi kerja di seluruh wilayah operasional perusahaan di Indonesia.

Kualifikasi Pekerjaan

• Pendidikan minimal S1/D4 Teknik Mesin atau Teknik Mekatronika.
• Memiliki pengalaman kerja minimal 2 tahun di bidang engineering, maintenance, atau manufaktur.
• Mampu berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa Inggris secara aktif, baik lisan maupun tulisan.
• Kemampuan berbahasa Mandarin menjadi nilai tambah.
• Menguasai SAP PM, AutoCAD 2D/3D Drawing, dan Microsoft Office.
• Menguasai software analisis dan desain mekanikal seperti SolidWorks, Ansys, atau Inventor.
• Memahami konsep dan implementasi CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System).
• Memiliki pengetahuan mengenai preventive, predictive, dan corrective maintenance.
• Memiliki pemahaman dasar mengenai mechanical engineering dan kemampuan multitasking yang baik.
• Mampu menganalisis permasalahan secara sistematis serta memberikan solusi yang efektif.
• Memiliki jiwa kepemimpinan, integritas tinggi, profesionalisme, dan kreativitas.
• Memahami standar K3 Industri serta sistem manajemen mutu ISO 9001:2015.
• Memahami konsep dan implementasi teknologi IoT di lingkungan industri.
• Bersedia ditempatkan di seluruh wilayah Indonesia.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
